_comment: Phase HM-X1.3 -- byte-identical to v3 in every field except supportedRunsPerWeek, which is widened from [5] to [6]. Same structural necessity as half-marathon-master.v4.json (see its own comment): PlanCatalog.Core's CatalogGraphValidator (TC_LAYOUT_RUNS_PER_WEEK_NOT_SUPPORTED) hard-fails for any combination whose bound RUN_LAYOUT's runsPerWeek is absent from its master's own supportedRunsPerWeek array. v3 itself is left completely untouched (still [5], still what half-marathon-5d-advanced.v1.json resolves) -- zero delta for the existing public 5D Advanced combination. Reuses v3's own workoutProgression pointer (HALF_MARATHON_WORKOUT_PROGRESSION v3, Advanced's KEY2/THRESHOLD_TEMPO lane-1 content) unmodified -- lane binding is layout-driven, not frequency-driven (HM-X1.2 SS7). CoreCycle (10/14/16) and the 2-week Taper phase are unchanged. No third KEY_SESSION slot is introduced by this template.
